ownership.quote: The company went public on the New York Stock Exchange in 2019 under the ticker symbol NET.

stage.quote: On August 15, 2019, Cloudflare submitted its S-1 filing for an initial public offering on the New York Stock Exchange under the stock ticker NET. It opened for public trading on September 13, 2019, at $15 per share.
stage.note: Cloudflare (parent company of the Sandbox SDK / Containers product) has been a public company (NYSE: NET) since its September 13, 2019 IPO. The Sandbox SDK / Containers product itself is a feature of the Workers platform, not a separately funded entity.

note: Cloudflare Sandbox SDK / Containers is a product feature of Cloudflare's Workers developer platform, not a standalone company. Cloudflare, Inc. (NYSE: NET) is a public company founded in 2009 by Matthew Prince, Michelle Zatlyn, and Lee Holloway, headquartered in San Francisco; it IPO'd September 13, 2019. Company-wide revenue ($2.168B FY2025, $1.670B FY2024) and employee count are for all of Cloudflare, not this specific product; the Sandbox SDK/container bridge code is open source but the underlying execution platform cannot be self-hosted.
